Коробка навколо тонкого тіла згущує гори: A box around a thin body refines piles of empty air above and below it. A shell is set by DISTANCE from the surface, so it follows the shape: thin at the edge, thicker where the body is thick. On the test aircraft the box takes 2.3 m³, the shell 0.077 — thirty times less at the same resolution near the wall. The zone also goes in front of the nose: the distance is measured in all directions.
Коробка навколо тіла зі слідом: Box around the body with wake
Коробка, всередині якої потік гальмуєтьс: A box inside which the flow slows down as if an obstacle stood in it. This is how radiators, inlet screens, filters and parachutes are computed: there is no sense in modeling every opening.

Показник — градієнт тиску, помножений на: The indicator is the pressure gradient multiplied by the cell size, plus vorticity. Multiplication by the size turns the steepness of the field into an error estimate on the cell. Vorticity is added for the WAKE: in it the pressure is flat, and the pressure gradient is blind there. In a test, the zone from the gradient alone extended 0.4 m from the nose, and with vorticity — 6.8 m, that is, together with the wake.

Each number comes with an explanation of where it comes from.

Стеля {v:.1f} млн комірок — мʼяка: OpenF: The cap of {v:.1f} M cells is soft: OpenFOAM adds a whole level before it checks the margin, and then adds neighbors for the 2:1 rule. In a test the mesh came out 22% larger. Plan memory for about {v2:.1f} M.
Стіки задають ПОЗИЦІЮ, в якій рахуватиме: The sticks set the POSITION in which the case is computed: the surfaces deflect to their angles, and this geometry goes into the mesh. This is not flight — the run is steady, and the aircraft is frozen in it.
Схеми першого порядку, низька релаксація: First-order schemes, low relaxation, speed cap
Сітка вже має рівень {base}; ділити дозв: The mesh already has level {base}; division is allowed up to {top}. The smallest cell will be {v:.2f} mm (now {v2:.2f} mm).
Сітку будує сервер, як завжди, — одразу: The server builds the mesh, as always — directly into as many pieces as there are processes in total. The solver runs on all machines: each gets only its own pieces, and at the end they come back to the server. All processes run in the same OpenFOAM container (opencfd/openfoam-run:2512). Pieces are split by speed: each machine runs a short benchmark once (stored on the server), and a machine that is busy now gets less. Measured: 3 machines with 4 cores each — three times faster than one. Only for “Run on Server”.
У WSL уже є Ubuntu — лишилося поставити: WSL already has Ubuntu — only OpenFOAM itself is left to install. The button opens a WSL console and runs the command; apt asks for the sudo password, so this step is interactive.
У каталозі {root} кейсів немає. Створіть: There are no cases in {root}. Create a case on the “Run” tab — it will show up here.
У кейсі «{name}» немає ні каталогів proc: Case “{name}” has no processor* folders and no intermediate time directories.
Увесь прогін стійкий. limitVelocity зріж: The whole run is robust. limitVelocity clips the speed above {cap:.4g} m/s.
Це імʼя теки кейсу: літери, цифри, «_»,: This is the case folder name: letters, digits, “_”, “.” and “-”. All other characters (colon, space, quotes…) become “_”.
Циліндр, усередині якого повітря рахуєть: A cylinder inside which the air is computed in a rotating reference frame (MRF). This is how propellers are computed without moving the mesh. IMPORTANT: the thrust comes not from the zone but from the blades inside it — the propeller geometry must be in the scene.
Чому кейс копіюється в WSL: Why the case is copied into WSL
Layer {thickness} thick along the flow. Coefficients for OpenFOAM: d = {d:.4g}, f = {f:.4g}.

Швидкість кожної машини міряється коротк: The speed of each machine is measured with a short benchmark and stored on the server (it is measured again when the processor changed, 30 days passed, or the last measurement was under load). With the checkbox — measure all machines again at the next check.
